title: Pico vs Q-Switch Laser: Which Is Better?
h1: Pico laser vs Q-switch laser: how they differ
desc: Pico laser vs Q-switch laser compared for pigmentation, melasma, tattoos and skin texture: pulse length, sessions, downtime and suitability for darker skin.
answer: Both lasers break up pigment with very short pulses. Q-switch pulses last nanoseconds and work mainly through heat; pico pulses last picoseconds, around a thousand times shorter, and work mainly through pressure. Pico often clears pigment and ink in fewer sessions with less heat, while Q-switch remains effective and more affordable for many spots.
facts: Both; pico better for stubborn colours
body:
## For pigmentation

Sun spots and freckles respond well to both. Pico's lower heat can suit darker skin and more sensitive pigmentation, with less risk of rebound darkening.

## For tattoos

Black ink clears well with both. Pico breaks ink into finer particles, which can help with stubborn or coloured tattoos and older treatments that have plateaued.

## For texture

Pico with a focusing lens creates tiny areas of collagen stimulation under the skin, improving fine lines and mild acne scars with little downtime.
faq: Not always. Q-switch is very effective for many spots and costs less.
Which is safer for dark skin?
Both can be safe with correct settings; pico's lower heat is often preferred.
